Event

The Red Affair

Wed, Jan 13, 2016 · 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

When
Wed, Jan 13, 2016 · 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

The Red Affair has asked me to judge the Best Dressed at their 2nd Annual event. The Red Affair is an amazing event that raises money for Avenues For Homeless Youth. Avenues is a non-profit dedicated to help homeless youth transition.

I learned that approximately 40% of the kids they take in are GLBT. Research shows that on any given night 4,000+ kids are homeless in Minnesota. Cmon… Tickets start at $55 and you get complimentary beverages until 10:30 and concert with Purple Xperience. My friends Esera Tuaolo and Miss Shannon Paul are also involved.

Get dressed up and join me on Saturday, February 6th for The Red Affair to benefit Avenues For Homeless Youth.

More information and buy tickets here.
